content.summary: Civil infrastructure construction company Sterling Infrastructure (NASDAQ:STRL) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 16% year on year to $689 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.38 billion at the midpoint came in 5.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.48 per share was 22.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
